question:
**Direction: A part of the given sentence that has been underlined may contain a spelling error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the spelling error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.**

Writing under a **__psuedonym__** might not give one the actual recognition that he / she deserves.
solution:
The correct answer is** ​"Pseudonym."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **'Pseudonym.'**
 
• 'Pseudonym' means a name used by somebody, especially a writer, instead of his/her real name. (छद्मनाम, उपनाम (असली नाम के बदले प्रयुक्त, विशेषतः किसी लेखक द्वारा))

 
 
• Example: *She writes under a **pseudonym**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
